mapper.sql: RAWTOHEX(i.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(i.format_check_id) AS formatCheckId, RAWTOHEX(i.rule_id) AS ruleId, i.issue_type AS issueType, i.location_type AS locationType, JSON_SERIALIZE(i.location_ref RETURNING VARCHAR2(4000)) AS locationRef, i.expected_value AS expectedValue, i.actual_value AS actualValue, i.severity, i.auto_fixable AS autoFixable, i.fix_status AS fixStatus, i.guidance
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO edudoc_format_issue (id, format_check_id, rule_id, issue_type, location_type, location_ref, expected_value, actual_value, severity, auto_fixable, fix_status, guidance)
SELECT HEXTORAW(#{i.id}), HEXTORAW(#{i.formatCheckId}), HEXTORAW(#{i.ruleId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), #{i.issueType}, #{i.locationType}, CAST(#{i.locationRef, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSON), #{i.expectedValue, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{i.actualValue, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{i.severity}, #{i.autoFixable}, #{i.fixStatus}, #{i.guidance, jdbcType=VARCHAR} FROM DUAL
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edudoc_format_issue i WHERE i.format_check_id = HEXTORAW(#{checkId}) AND i.severity = #{severity} ORDER BY DECODE(i.severity, 'BLOCKER', 0, 'WARNING', 1, 2), i.create_time OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT FROM edudoc_format_issue i WHERE i.id IN HEXTORAW(#{id})
